speaker: philip_henslowe
text: Master Shakespeare. I was counting. The play is a different sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was at your house. The flag was up.

speaker: philip_henslowe
text: You've a pretty wit, Master Shakespeare. Does it pay?

speaker: philip_henslowe
text: Ah. I pay by the play. Six pound, and I never argue the jig.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am for the other side. Good day, Master Henslowe.
